newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest bourse council approves new members.
newsitem.headline: Budapest bourse council approves new members.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange's council approved two new members and delayed approval of the membership request of a third securities house until it submits "The bourse council approved the membership application of Cashline who will take the place of IBB which left the bourse," Jozsef Rotyis, CEO of the Budapest Stock Exchange told a news conference on Friday
"The council also approved the membership of Wood and Co," he said, adding Wood and Co operates in several eastern European countries.
The bourse council delayed the membership request of Diana Investment until the securities house supplies missing details of its shareholding structure, Rotyis said.
